chosen_for_reproducibility: 6h window, 30min sequence GRU; selection among GRUs only and shorter-window absolute MAE is not a fair cross-horizon score
matched_0_6h_comparison: GRU 1.851h MAE versus Dummy 1.393h and Tree 1.545h on identical 901 validation rows; no performance improvement
model1_connection: Only 23.98% of Model 1 trigger rows have a continuous 30-minute sequence; conditional trigger MAE 1.844h on 6095 rows with real fault within 6h
dashboard_decision: Do not display point RUL or an empirical range as a reliable fault-time forecast. Model remains a research artifact, not final Model 2.
independent_validation: The same development validation selected the configuration; no independent final test was used.
